cover: When it's time to leave WordPress

slides.title: Plugins nobody dares update
slides.body: A dozen updates waiting, and nobody sure which one breaks the site. Every plugin is more code to attack.

slides.title: Every page view runs PHP
slides.body: A database behind every visit, and mobile PageSpeed scores in the red.

slides.title: When staying is fine
slides.body: A few plugins, painless updates and fast pages on a phone. Then WordPress is doing its job.

slides.title: Keep the editor you know
slides.body: WordPress can stay as the back office. Visitors get pre-built pages and never touch it.

slides.title: Every URL kept
slides.body: Each old URL maps to its new address with a 301 redirect, so search rankings carry over.

slides.title: The old site stays live
slides.body: We switch DNS only once the new site checks out.
